text:
maya (PM): Need quick decision for DP invite copy + tracks. Options: "light" (docs + 2 office hours) x6 partners or "full" (VPC/SSO + config UI) x3 partners. Constraint: Eng can only ship full for 3 in the next 6w. input?

jun (Eng): FYI full = ~3 sprints infra + 1 UI. light = ~1 sprint telemetry + runbook. If we promise full and can't deliver, ops debt skyrockets.

lena (Solutions): Sales prefers full for 2 strategic prospects, but others are fine with light. We could invite 6 and tag 2 as "high-touch" candidates for escalation.

omar (ProdResearch): From signal side, more partners -> more prompt diversity. Recommend light-by-default, full-by-request. Need telemetry mandatory to run evals.

zoe (Legal): Quick heads-up: any private deploy needs a short addendum. I can prepare a 1-pager. Also data-handling checkbox in intake form.

maya (PM): Proposed acceptance gates for light track: 1) partner signs pilot addendum; 2) telemetry enabled (request id + sample); 3) partner runs smoke request within 5 days; 4) no >2 high-sev regressions. For full track: add SSO + sample VPC manifest delivered before cutover. Thoughts?

jun (Eng): gates look good. Add fallback: if full misses ETA, we offer partner the light onboarding or defer to next cohort. Also add a latency SLO: p50 < 150ms for standard prompts or auto-fallback to hosted model.

lena (Solutions): I'll add a checkbox "I require private deploy" on intake and a priority field. Also drafting partner invite language to be transparent about tracks + fallback.

omar (ProdResearch): Measurement plan (short): onboard_time, active_requests/week, eval_regressions, partner_sat (0-10). Will create dashboard slices and a T+2 / T+6 survey.

zoe (Legal): Template addendum ready Tue. Recommend we include a liability cap and anonymized telemetry clause.

deploy-bot: Reminder: DP staging deploy scheduled 2024-06-02T20:00Z (1717720800). Toggle migrations if needed.

maya (PM): Actions: Jun -> telemetry + fallback plan estimate by Tue EOD. Lena -> intake checkbox + invite draft by Tue EOD. Omar -> dashboard + survey templates by Wed. Zoe -> draft addendum Tue. Meeting Wed 10:00 to finalize invites. :white_check_mark:
